scope: Free-first US equity event and positioning evidence

sources.coverage: Retained full master-index row queue, with optional explicit form filter and separately sourced CIK-to-symbol mappings
sources.timing: Index and filing dates do not establish precise publication or availability; retain actual retrieval and later mapping availability
limits: Configured SEC client contact required for automated acquisition
Missing, future or ambiguous symbol mappings remain unresolved
Constructed filing document links have not been fetched
A structurally valid retained file does not certify upstream or full-universe completeness
More than 10000 emitted rows require explicitly partitioned downstream institutional envelopes
Amendments need explicit filter names and source-bound ancestry; their labels do not identify exact replacements
sources.rights: Review SEC access terms and any filing-content rights for the intended use; no API subscription is required

sources.coverage: Recent filer submission metadata; older filenames retained but never automatically crawled
sources.timing: Updated as filings are disseminated; reporting, acceptance and first-observed clocks differ
limits: Filer CIK/tickers may not identify each transaction issuer
13D/G labels are metadata, not parsed ownership percentages
An amendment label does not identify an exact superseded record
Use a configured research-client contact, never discovered personal credentials
sources.rights: Retain SEC website and filing-content terms; parser does not establish rights

sources.coverage: Raw ownership XML transaction codes, acquired/disposed flags, amounts, owners and footnotes
sources.timing: Transaction dates are reporting facts, not intraday public availability
limits: A disposal is not automatically a discretionary sale or short position
Review derivative terms, ownership capacity, footnotes and amendments

sources.coverage: Reported holdings with CUSIP, class, put/call, quantity type and original value
sources.timing: Quarterly reported positions with filing lag, generally due within 45 days after quarter end
limits: Short equity/options positions are omitted; a reported put is not a short stock position
No current trade time, complete hedge exposure or purchase cost
Value units changed in January 2023; explicitly declare USD or USD_thousands, otherwise unknown
No automatic CUSIP-to-ticker mapping

sources.coverage: Selected TRF/ADF/ORF regular-hours public volume file, not all-market positions
sources.timing: FINRA states posting by 18:00 ET on trade date; updates can appear later. Never infer actual availability from this schedule
limits: ShortVolume already includes short-exempt volume
Not short interest, net position change or aggressor intent
Consolidated and facility files overlap
November 2026 file visibly includes fractional shares despite older integer-only layout text
Numeric trailer must reconcile or parsed rows are ineligible
sources.rights: FINRA terms apply; public readability does not establish commercial redistribution rights

intended_use_review.limits: General website terms restrict AI use and bulk extraction. Any applicable source-specific agreement or exception must be established; public download access does not establish permission.

sources.coverage: Dated reported short shares, source-provided average volume and displayed days to cover
sources.timing: Twice-monthly settlement snapshots; publication and retrieval occur later
limits: Not live short positions or borrow inventory
Displayed days-to-cover conventions differ from an unrounded newly calculated ratio
Float, share-class, adjustment and ADV-window compatibility must be supplied
Unknown export headers remain explicit parse gaps
sources.rights: Review FINRA terms and API/export entitlements

intended_use_review.limits: General website terms restrict AI use and bulk extraction. Any applicable source-specific agreement or exception must be established; public download access does not establish permission.

sources.coverage: Cboe-listed securities only; observed Cboe CSV column aliases supported
sources.timing: Use Cycle Settlement Date as the position measurement date and actual first-observed retrieval for availability; filename and Last-Modified are not historical availability proof
limits: The observed Cboe file uses BATS-Symbol, Cycle Settlement Date, current-cycle net-short shares, cycle average daily trade volume and minimum trade-days-to-cover columns; preserve original field names/values and split/manual-revision indicators.

One bounded public-file acquisition and raw-file parse were observed on November 12, 2026; this is a scoped connection/schema check, not complete historical/live feed coverage or future endpoint reliability.
Source-reported minimum days to cover and cycle average volume are not an independently calculated complete-window ratio.
No float, issuer/share-class mapping, adjustment compatibility, borrow supply or trading authority is established by this file.
sources.rights: Cboe terms apply; free access is not an unrestricted license

intended_use_review.limits: A personal-copy permission does not establish commercial redistribution, unrestricted retention or AI/cloud processing rights.

sources.coverage: NSCC aggregate outstanding fail balances by settlement date/security
sources.timing: Half-month files posted with lag; SEC does not guarantee a posting date
limits: Do not sum daily balances as new fails or infer their age
Fails can arise from long or short sales and do not prove abusive short selling
Price is prior-day close or unavailable; a dot is unknown
Missing rows are not automatically filled with zero
sources.rights: Retain SEC qualifications and applicable content terms

sources.timing: Delayed aggregates; retain actual publication and revision metadata
limits: No individual dark-pool prints, side or beneficial-owner identity

No authenticated FINRA API is implemented
